Title: Admin may see status cards displaying "Unknown" instead of the expected summary counts in Intune admin center

User impact: Admin may see status cards displaying "Unknown" instead of the expected summary counts in Intune admin center.

More info: Admins are impacted when accessing the Home and Troubleshooting Blades. 

As a workaround, admins can click the "Unknown" status, which will allow access to the data.
 

Current status: We've identified an issue that is preventing expected status cards for admins accessing the Home and Troubleshooting Blades in the Intune admin center. We're analyzing system logging and recent updates to the service, as we isolate the source for this event and determine our next troubleshooting steps for remediating the impact.

Scope of impact: This issue may affect any admin accessing the Intune admin center from Home and Troubleshooting Blades.
 

Next update by: Tuesday, October 13, 2026, at 9:30 PM UTC

Title: Admin may see status cards displaying "Unknown" instead of the expected summary counts in Intune admin center

User impact: Admin may see status cards displaying "Unknown" instead of the expected summary counts in Intune admin center.

More info: Admins are impacted when accessing the Home, Apps, Devices, and Troubleshooting Blades. 

As a workaround, admins can click the "Unknown" status, which will allow access to the data.
 

Current status: We've identified a recent misconfigured service update that is producing unexpected status card displays for admins in the Intune admin center. We're conducting our change reversion process to remove the offending change and to remediate the impact.

Scope of impact: This issue may affect any admin accessing the Intune admin center from Home and Troubleshooting Blades.
 

Root cause: An incorrectly scoped Microsoft Graph flight changed the response format for batch requests across production. Some Intune UX experiences (Home, Apps, Devices, Troubleshooting) rely on the previous Base64-encoded behavior and can't parse the JSON response, resulting in status cards displaying "Unknown."

Next update by: Tuesday, October 13, 2026, at 11:30 PM UTC
